newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Singapore soldier dies in NZ army vehicle crash.
newsitem.headline: Singapore soldier dies in NZ army vehicle crash.

text.p: A Singaporean soldier was killed and another seriously injured on Friday after their Land Rover rolled and crashed at a New Zealand military camp, the New Zealand army said.
Lieutenant Colonel Colin Richardson said the accident happened when the Singapore army vehicle with four Singaporean soldiers on board overturned on army land at Waiouru in the central North Island.
He said one soldier died and another, with serious injuries, was flown by helicopter to a hospital in the city of Palmerston North. The other two soldiers were not seriously hurt.

Richardson said the soldiers were from the Singapore 23rd Artillery Battalion and had been in New Zealand for about a week for training. They had been on a live-fire exercise at the time of the accident.
